SIGHT AND EYES. [5] [Kalm.]
Pain in eyes, which makes it painful to turn them.
Sensation of stiffness in muscles around eyes, and of eyelids.
Asthenopia ; stiff, drawing sensation in muscles upon moving eyes.
   

HEART, PULSE AND CIRCULATION. [29] [Kalm.]
Paroxysms of anguish about heart, dyspnœa, febrile excitement ; rheumatic endocarditis, with consequent hypertrophy and valvular disease.
Wandering rheumatic pains in region of heart, extending down left arm.
Heart disease, after frequent attacks of rheumatism, or alternating with it.
Hypertrophy and valvular insufficiency, or thickening, after rheumatism, paroxysms of anguish about heart, with dyspnœa and febrile excitement.
   

OUTER CHEST. [30] [Kalm.]
Pleuritis falsa in winter season.
   

NERVES. [36] [Kalm.]
Weakness the only general symptom with neuralgia.
   

FEVER. [40] [Kalm.]
Chilliness, with coldness ; shaking chill in cold air ; chills run over back.
